line: Crowley's Four of Disks is the card for the third decan of Capricorn, with the Sun as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Capricorn.

quotes.quote: The card is ruled by the Sun in Capricornus

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This represents Law and Order, maintained by constant authority and vigilance.
